{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
WORKDIR="cpu_check_workspace"
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
# Pre-checksum of a few persistent files to verify we won't alter them
PRECHK="$WORKDIR/pre_checksums.txt"
POSTCHK="$WORKDIR/post_checksums.txt"
{ sha256sum /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || true; } > "$PRECHK"

# Collect raw artifacts
lscpu > "$WORKDIR/system_info.raw" 2>/dev/null || uname -a > "$WORKDIR/system_info.raw"
cat /proc/cpuinfo > "$WORKDIR/cpuinfo.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
cat /proc/stat > "$WORKDIR/cpu_metrics.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online > "$WORKDIR/cpu_online.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
nproc > "$WORKDIR/nproc.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
uname -a > "$WORKDIR/uname.raw" 2>/dev/null || true

# Parsing (write to temp files then move)
# system_info.parsed
{
  echo "--- lscpu key fields (if present) ---"
  grep -E "^CPU\(s\):|^Thread\(s\) per core:|^Core\(s\) per socket:|^Socket\(s\):|^Model name:|^Architecture:|^Vendor ID:|^CPU MHz:" "$WORKDIR/system_info.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "--- uname ---"
  cat "$WORKDIR/uname.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
} > "$WORKDIR/system_info.parsed"

# cpuinfo.parsed
{
  echo "--- processor count (by /proc/cpuinfo) ---"
  grep -c "^processor" "$WORKDIR/cpuinfo.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "--- unique model name(s) ---"
  grep -m1 "model name" -m 1 "$WORKDIR/cpuinfo.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "--- sample CPU MHz lines ---"
  grep "cpu MHz" "$WORKDIR/cpuinfo.raw" 2>/dev/null | head -n 4 || true
} > "$WORKDIR/cpuinfo.parsed"

# cpu_metrics.parsed
{
  echo "--- /proc/stat cpu lines (aggregate + per-cpu) ---"
  grep "^cpu" "$WORKDIR/cpu_metrics.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "--- uptime ---"
  uptime 2>/dev/null || true
} > "$WORKDIR/cpu_metrics.parsed"

# Cross-checks and discrepancies
DIS="$WORKDIR/discrepancies.log"
: > "$DIS"
# read numbers
NP=$(cat "$WORKDIR/nproc.raw" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
LSCPU=$(grep -E "^CPU\(s\):" "$WORKDIR/system_info.raw" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{print $2+0}' || echo "")
CPUINFO_COUNT=$(grep -c "^processor" "$WORKDIR/cpuinfo.raw" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
# parse online
ONLINE_RAW=$(cat "$WORKDIR/cpu_online.raw" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
# compute online count
parse_online_count() {
  s="$1"
  [ -z "$s" ] && { echo ""; return; }
  # expand ranges like 0-3,0,5
  IFS=',' read -ra parts <<< "$s"
  cnt=0
  for p in "${parts[@]}"; do
    if [[ "$p" =~ ^([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
      a=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
      b=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
      cnt=$((cnt + b - a + 1))
    elif [[ "$p" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
      cnt=$((cnt + 1))
    fi
  done
  echo "$cnt"
}
ONLINE_COUNT=$(parse_online_count "$ONLINE_RAW")

# write comparisons
echo "nproc reported: ${NP}" >> "$DIS"
echo "lscpu reported (CPU(s)): ${LSCPU}" >> "$DIS"
echo "/proc/cpuinfo processor count: ${CPUINFO_COUNT}" >> "$DIS"
echo "/sys/devices/system/cpu/online expanded count: ${ONLINE_COUNT} (raw: ${ONLINE_RAW})" >> "$DIS"

# Check for mismatches
if [ -n "$NP" ] && [ -n "$LSCPU" ] && [ "$NP" != "$LSCPU" ]; then
  echo "Mismatch: nproc (${NP}) != lscpu CPU(s) (${LSCPU})" >> "$DIS"
fi
if [ -n "$NP" ] && [ -n "$CPUINFO_COUNT" ] && [ "$NP" != "$CPUINFO_COUNT" ]; then
  echo "Mismatch: nproc (${NP}) != /proc/cpuinfo count (${CPUINFO_COUNT})" >> "$DIS"
fi
if [ -n "$NP" ] && [ -n "$ONLINE_COUNT" ] && [ "$NP" != "$ONLINE_COUNT" ]; then
  echo "Mismatch: nproc (${NP}) != online count (${ONLINE_COUNT})" >> "$DIS"
fi
if [ -s "$DIS" ]; then
  echo "Discrepancies recorded in $DIS" > "$WORKDIR/discrepancies.log.tmp"
  cat "$DIS" >> "$WORKDIR/discrepancies.log.tmp"
  mv "$WORKDIR/discrepancies.log.tmp" "$DIS"
else
  echo "No discrepancies detected across gathered CPU indicators." >> "$DIS"
fi

# Safety check: post-checksums
{ sha256sum /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || true; } > "$POSTCHK"

SAF="$WORKDIR/safety_check.log"
: > "$SAF"
if cmp -s "$PRECHK" "$POSTCHK" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "OK: Checked files unchanged: /etc/passwd, /etc/group, /etc/hosts" >> "$SAF"
else
  echo "WARNING: Some checked persistent files changed during operation (unexpected)." >> "$SAF"
  echo "Pre-checksums:" >> "$SAF"
  cat "$PRECHK" >> "$SAF"
  echo "Post-checksums:" >> "$SAF"
  cat "$POSTCHK" >> "$SAF"
fi
# Note what we changed
echo "Workspace created at $(realpath "$WORKDIR")" >> "$SAF"

# Remove transient files (we used none outside WORKDIR except PRECHK/POSTCHK which we keep inside)
# Ensure only keep raw, parsed, discrepancies.log, safety_check.log
# Remove any temp .tmp files
rm -f "$WORKDIR"/*.tmp 2>/dev/null || true

# Consolidate summary
SUMMARY="$WORKDIR/cpu_summary.txt"
: > "$SUMMARY"
{
  echo "CPU Summary"
  echo "=========="
  echo "Number reported by nproc: ${NP}"
  echo "Number reported by lscpu (CPU(s)): ${LSCPU}"
  echo "/proc/cpuinfo processor count: ${CPUINFO_COUNT}"
  echo "/sys/devices/system/cpu/online expanded count: ${ONLINE_COUNT} (raw: ${ONLINE_RAW})"
  echo
  echo "Model (sample):"
  grep -m1 "model name" "$WORKDIR/cpuinfo.raw" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "Unresolved discrepancies (if any):"
  if grep -q "Mismatch" "$DIS" 2>/dev/null; then
    grep "Mismatch" "$DIS" || true
  else
    echo "None"
  fi
  echo
  echo "For full details see: $WORKDIR/system_info.raw, $WORKDIR/cpuinfo.raw, $WORKDIR/cpu_metrics.raw, $WORKDIR/system_info.parsed, $WORKDIR/cpuinfo.parsed, $WORKDIR/cpu_metrics.parsed, $WORKDIR/discrepancies.log, $WORKDIR/safety_check.log"
  echo "Summary ready for inspection."
} > "$SUMMARY"

# Final output: print number of CPUs (nproc) to stdout so controller can capture answer
cat "$WORKDIR/nproc.raw"
"}
